current.name: CURRENT_LOGICAL_ARTIFACT_KEY_V1
current.serialization: length-prefixed UTF-8 field-name/value pairs in listed order; null is serialized as the literal <NULL>

derivation.forecastOrigin: canonical latest observation/origin selected from the exact history used for compute
derivation.horizonConfigurationId: canonical identifier or checksum of the exact Current target/horizon set resolved before ownership acquisition

current.sharingRule: Share in-flight work only when every listed field is exactly equal.
current.sourceBoundary: apps/sg-runtime/lib/forecast/service.ts ForecastCacheLookupKey plus explicit origin and horizon configuration isolation required by this experiment

verification.name: VERIFICATION_LOGICAL_ARTIFACT_KEY_V1
verification.serialization: length-prefixed UTF-8 field-name/value pairs in listed order; null is serialized as the literal <NULL>

derivation.verificationHorizonSetId: canonical identifier or checksum of the exact Verification horizon set
derivation.verificationConfigurationId: canonical identifier or checksum of the backtest configuration resolved before ownership acquisition
derivation.originPolicyId: canonical identifier for the expanding-origin/origin-selection policy

verification.sharingRule: Share in-flight work only when every listed field is exactly equal; never share with CURRENT.
verification.sourceBoundary: apps/sg-runtime/lib/forecast/service.ts ForecastCacheLookupKey and persisted Verification horizons/origins

providerHistory.name: PROVIDER_HISTORY_REQUEST_KEY_V1
providerHistory.serialization: length-prefixed UTF-8 field-name/value pairs in listed order

derivation.coverageState: exact pre-fetch cache decision: miss, partial, stale, or db-unavailable
derivation.freshnessReference: lastProviderFetchAt or latestStoredObservationAt used by the cache decision
derivation.freshnessPolicyId: identifier for frequencyFreshnessWindowMs and range coverage policy

providerHistory.sharingRule: Provider acquisition may share only for the same exact provider request and the same cache decision inputs; it remains independent from Forecast Current ownership.

persistence.name: PERSISTENCE_OWNERSHIP_KEY_V1
persistence.serialization: length-prefixed UTF-8 field-name/value pairs in listed order
persistence.artifactLogicalKeyRule: Embed the complete CURRENT_LOGICAL_ARTIFACT_KEY_V1 or VERIFICATION_LOGICAL_ARTIFACT_KEY_V1; no coarse series-only or series-plus-model identity is lawful.
persistence.sharingRule: Persistence ownership is evaluated independently in Phase 2.2B-3 after measuring whether one compute owner already yields one lawful write-set.
persistence.sourceBoundary: Forecast run upsert plus replacement point/metric/record write-set

roles.OWNER: The sole execution that lawfully performs missing-artifact work for one exact logical key during its in-flight interval.
roles.WAITER: A concurrent requester that observes the same exact key in flight and awaits that owner's canonical result without starting compute.
roles.PREPARED_READER: A requester served by the exact READY persisted artifact after exact identity and freshness checks, with no Forecast compute.

sameKey.overlapRule: Use observed overlap; do not infer waiter count from submitted request count.

smallPool.expectedComputeOwnerFormula: count(distinct exact missing logicalArtifactKey observed concurrently)

ownerSuccess.required: Owner completes lawful compute and existing persistence behavior; all attached waiters receive the same canonical result identity and values.
ownerSuccess.release: Release only after the owner result and required persistence attempt have settled; emit release timing.

ownerFailure.required: All currently attached waiters observe the same owner failure classification; the entry is removed in a finally-equivalent path; a later request may retry.
ownerFailure.partialPersistence: May be reused only after the normal exact prepared-artifact read proves a complete lawful artifact; otherwise treat as MISS.

waiterCancellation.required: Cancellation is local to that waiter and does not cancel the owner while any lawful consumer or required persistence completion remains.

ownerDisconnect.currentObservedBoundary: Dashboard client abort is not propagated as a Forecast compute cancellation signal in the inspected runtime path.
ownerDisconnect.requiredExperimentSemantics: An HTTP owner-request disconnect does not by itself cancel shared compute; observe owner completion/failure and remaining waiter outcomes.

timeout.policy: Phase 2.2B-1 observes timeout risk before proposing any new value.

lateArrival.duringCompute: Join as WAITER only when the exact key remains IN_FLIGHT.
lateArrival.afterPersistenceBeforeRelease: Join the extant exact-key owner; telemetry must reveal this interval.
lateArrival.afterReady: Use PREPARED_READER path after exact prepared validation.
lateArrival.afterReleaseWithoutReady: Treat as MISS and permit a new owner.

releaseRace.required: Correlate compute end, persistence end, entry release, prepared availability, and any subsequent owner acquisition for the same key.
releaseRace.acceptance: No second owner starts while a valid exact-key entry is still IN_FLIGHT.

fingerprintChange.required: Different historyFingerprint or lawful forecast origin produces a different key and prohibits ownership sharing.

formulas.DUPLICATE_COMPUTE_COUNT: max(0, ACTUAL_COMPUTE_COUNT - LOGICAL_ARTIFACT_COUNT) when one lawful compute is established per exact key
formulas.P50_CHANGE: AFTER_P50 - BEFORE_P50; NOT_COMPARABLE when either value is absent
formulas.P95_CHANGE: AFTER_P95 - BEFORE_P95; NOT_COMPARABLE when either value is absent
formulas.P99_CHANGE: AFTER_P99 - BEFORE_P99; NOT_COMPARABLE when either value is absent
formulas.THROUGHPUT_CHANGE: AFTER_THROUGHPUT - BEFORE_THROUGHPUT; NOT_COMPARABLE when either value is absent

correctnessEquivalence.comparison: Exact deterministic equality or canonical checksum where supported; retain only existing lawful numerical tolerance.

P03.before: 10 requests, 1 logical Current key, 10 computes, 9 duplicates per model

P04.before: At 100 requests: 3 logical keys, 100 computes, 97 duplicates
P04.afterStructuralInvariant: One owner per exact distinct missing request key; 0 duplicate computes

P05.before: 10 requests, 1 logical Current key, 10 computes, 9 duplicates, 9 duplicate artifact writes
P05.afterStructuralInvariant: Current and provider-history ownership measured separately

P08.before: 2 requests, 1 logical Verification key, 2 full computes, 1 duplicate
P08.afterStructuralInvariant: 2 canonical responses, 1 Verification owner, 1 observed waiter

P11.afterStructuralInvariant: 2 canonical responses, 1 Current owner, 1 observed waiter

acceptanceModel.structuralTarget: ACTUAL_COMPUTE_OWNER_COUNT = LOGICAL_ARTIFACT_COUNT and DUPLICATE_COMPUTE_COUNT = 0 for exact overlapping misses

phaseScopes.2.2B-1: Smallest candidate in-process Current ownership mechanism; deterministic correctness, isolation, failure, cleanup, then small P03/P11 proof.
phaseScopes.2.2B-2: Independent Verification ownership; begin with exactly 2 concurrent callers and prove 1 owner, 1 waiter, 1 backtest.
phaseScopes.2.2B-3: Measure and establish canonical persistence ownership/idempotency without assuming extra protection is required.
phaseScopes.2.2B-4: Formal frozen BEFORE-versus-AFTER comparison for P03/P04/P05/P08/P11 plus prepared regressions.

limitations.registryCardinality: Only currently in-flight entries; never historical completed artifacts.
